data.name: Subtitle
data.value: Fix the keyboard layout and typos with a hotkey

data.name: AutoFixTypos_Hint
data.value: Works without the layout auto-correct too: then only typos are fixed. The hotkey always fixes both.

data.name: AutoCorrect_Blocked_Neural
data.value: Automatic fixes are unavailable while neural correction is on: the model works only on the hotkey.

data.name: AutoCorrect_Blocked_Plain
data.value: Automatic fixes are unavailable in layout-switch-only mode: without dictionaries there is nothing to check words against.

data.name: PlainSwitch_Hint
data.value: Swaps the characters as typed, without fixing typos. Works with nothing downloaded; press the hotkey again to try the next layout.

data.name: SwitchLayout
data.value: Switch the system layout after a correction

data.name: SwitchLayout_Hint
data.value: The hotkey always switches the language. This only applies to auto-after-space and correcting the selection.

data.name: Indicator_Label
data.value: Show the layout at the cursor

data.name: Indicator_Hint
data.value: A badge with the active layout next to the text cursor. Browsers and Electron apps usually hide it — they draw their own cursor.

data.name: SelectionHotkey_Hint
data.value: Corrects the selected text — in any window, however old the text is.

data.name: SelectionCase_Hint
data.value: Cycles the selection: UPPER CASE → lower case → Sentence case.

data.name: SelectionTranslit_Hint
data.value: Cyrillic or Greek ⇄ Latin. Press again to convert back.

data.name: SelectionRtl_Hint
data.value: Turns a Hebrew or Arabic line that arrived back-to-front the right way round.

data.name: Pref_Hint
data.value: Which language wins when a word fits several («молоток» in ru and uk).

data.name: Dict_Hint
data.value: Downloaded once, then they work offline. Without one a language is corrected worse.

data.name: AddLang_Tooltip
data.value: Download and add the selected language

data.name: Status_UnsupportedPlatform
data.value: Keyboard capture is not available on this platform yet. Settings, dictionaries, and login startup still work.

data.name: Status_AutoActive
data.value: Active. Words are corrected automatically after Space (and with “{0}”).

data.name: Status_HotkeyActive
data.value: Active. Type a word and press “{0}” — Lapsus fixes it in place.

data.name: Status_AccessibilityRequired
data.value: Couldn't start keyboard capture. Grant Accessibility access to Lapsus in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility (and Input Monitoring if listed), then restart the app.

data.name: Perm_Explain
data.value: Lapsus needs these permissions to see and correct what you type. Grant them below, then switch back here.

data.name: Status_UpdateNotSupported
data.value: This copy cannot update itself — download the latest release.

data.name: Diag_NoChange
data.value: Hotkey: “{0}” — every word looks correct, nothing to change.

data.name: Diag_NoSelection
data.value: Selection: nothing selected, or {0} does not answer a copy.

data.name: Diag_ClipboardFailed
data.value: Selection: the clipboard could not be used ({0}).

data.name: Diag_TapReenabled
data.value: Keyboard capture briefly stalled and was restarted. If this keeps happening, close a busy Accessibility client or grant Lapsus Input Monitoring.

data.name: Diag_NoDictionaries
data.value: Download at least one spelling dictionary in Settings before correcting layout.

data.name: Diag_SendFailed
data.value: SendInput failed (backspaces {0}/{1}, unicode {2}/{3}, error {4}, window: {5}). The target window is probably running as administrator.

data.name: Diag_NoLayoutList
data.value: Layout switch: the system returned no layout list.

data.name: Diag_LayoutNotInstalled
data.value: Layout {0} is not installed in Windows (available: {1}). Add it under Settings → Time & language → Language & region.

data.name: Diag_LayoutNotInstalled_Mac
data.value: Layout {0} is not installed on this Mac (available: {1}). Add it under System Settings → Keyboard → Input Sources.

data.name: Diag_InjectFailed
data.value: Couldn't inject keystrokes into the active app ({0}). Check Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions for Lapsus.

data.name: Diag_FocusChanged
data.value: Hotkey: ignored — focus moved to another window/app ({0}). Type again in the target field.

data.name: Diag_NoModel
data.value: Hotkey: neural correction is on, but no model is loaded. Download a model in Settings.

data.name: Neural_Hint
data.value: A local model, backed by the dictionaries. Turn on, download one, press the hotkey.

data.name: Model_DownloadEmpty
data.value: Model download returned no usable files.

data.name: Model_Loading
data.value: Loading {0} into memory… (first load can take a while)

data.name: Model_Ready
data.value: {0} ready — press the hotkey to rewrite the current line.

data.name: Model_ReadyOn
data.value: {0} ready on {1} — press the hotkey to rewrite the current line.

data.name: Model_NeedsDownload
data.value: Neural correction is on, but no model is installed. Download one above.

data.name: Model_CustomHint
data.value: Only models with an ONNX Runtime GenAI pack can run here, and the search keeps just those. A pasted org/name works too.

data.name: Status_NeuralHotkeyActive
data.value: Neural correction on — press {0} to rewrite the current line.

data.name: Status_NeuralFallbackActive
data.value: Neural correction on, but no model is loaded — “{0}” corrects with the dictionary until it is.

data.name: Diag_BufferChanged
data.value: Neural correction cancelled — the line changed while the model was running («{0}»).

data.name: Dict_Empty
data.value: No dictionaries yet — add a language above so corrections can use it.

data.name: Diag_ImeActive
data.value: Hotkey: ignored — the active input language (Chinese/Japanese/Korean) types through an IME, so Lapsus cannot rebuild that text from keystrokes.

data.name: Diag_DeadKeyPending
data.value: Hotkey: ignored — a dead key is still waiting for its letter. Type the letter or press ⌫, then try again.

data.name: Diag_SecureField
data.value: Hotkey: ignored — password / secure input. Lapsus never buffers or rewrites what you type there.

data.name: SkipPasswords_Hint
data.value: Password fields are never buffered when the OS lets us see them. Chrome/Electron often hide them; on Mac only Secure Input is visible. Idle text is wiped after one minute.

data.name: Excluded_Hint
data.value: Names, logins and brands never to touch.

data.name: ExcludedApps_Hint
data.value: Lapsus is fully off in these: no buffer, no hotkeys.

data.name: Model_DeviceHint
data.value: Available here: {0}. A pack built for another device still runs — on the processor.

data.name: Model_DeviceHintCpuOnly
data.value: No supported accelerator here, so the model runs on the processor.

data.name: Model_SearchPlaceholder
data.value: Search Hugging Face, or paste org/name

data.name: Model_SearchTooltip
data.value: Find models on Hugging Face that ship an ONNX Runtime GenAI pack

data.name: Model_SearchEmpty
data.value: Nothing found that ships an ONNX Runtime GenAI pack.

data.name: Lic_Free_Hint
data.value: Free for private people, freelancers included. Nothing is locked — a license covers use inside a company.

data.name: Lic_Key_Watermark
data.value: Paste the key from your purchase email

data.name: Lic_Buy_Hint
data.value: Pro is one private person. Business is per seat in a company.

data.name: About_License_Text
data.value: Free for private individuals. Companies pay per seat. Nothing is locked either way and nothing expires.

data.name: About_Donate_Hint
data.value: Lapsus is free for you, with no ads and no tracking. If it saves you time, you can chip in.

data.name: About_Dictionaries_Hint
data.value: Not shipped inside Lapsus: each is downloaded only when you add its language, and keeps its publisher's license.

data.name: About_Components_Hint
data.value: Shipped inside Lapsus, each under its own license.

data.name: Lic_Err_Malformed
data.value: That does not look like a Lapsus key. Check that the whole line was copied.

data.name: Lic_Err_Signature
data.value: This key was not issued for this build.

data.name: Lic_Err_NotConfigured
data.value: This build cannot check license keys.

data.name: Lic_Free_Managed
data.value: An organization runs this computer — a license is required.

data.name: LicRem_TrialHeadline
data.value: Lapsus is licensed per seat in a company. {0} days left to try it.

data.name: LicRem_DueHeadline
data.value: Lapsus needs a license on this computer.

data.name: LicRem_Body
data.value: This computer is administered by an organization (a domain, Entra ID or an MDM server). Lapsus is free for private people, freelancers included; use inside a company is paid, per seat.

data.name: LicRem_Why
data.value: Nothing is switched off and nothing is sent anywhere — the check runs on this machine only.

data.name: Lic_Err_Seats
data.value: All seats on this license are in use. Write to {0} to move a seat to this computer, or buy more.

data.name: Lic_Err_Offline
data.value: Could not reach the license server. The key is saved — activation will be retried.

data.name: Lic_Err_NoMachine
data.value: This computer could not be identified, so the license cannot be tied to it.
